name: repobuddy
description: RepoBuddy — Your GitHub project. Your technical interview.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,emerald" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build:client: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
